abstract: We study whether LLMs and cognitive skills influence the evaluation of novices’ intellectual tasks, when these evaluations depend on standard and well-defined performance criteria. This is a common case (junior employees, students’ exams) making our question relevant. In a 2×2 randomized control trial, we assign 1,053 first-year undergraduates in economics, management and finance to one of four conditions: a training on causal reasoning (as a relevant cognitive skill for intellectual tasks), ChatGPT Edu access (GPT-4o), both, or neither. We provide a real-world merchandising business problem and ask experts to evaluate the participants’ solutions according to standard metrics in marketing. We find that causal reasoning changes how students think, leading to mechanism-based solutions and a greater diversity of ideas. However, causal reasoning does not improve evaluations, unlike ChatGPT. Greater textual coherence and a higher number of ideas explain about half of the ChatGPT effect, suggesting that, for novices facing well-defined problems, LLMs produce solutions that resemble expert recommendations not only in textual quality, but also in content. We also find that, when combined with causal training, ChatGPT increases the use of coherent logic, falsification logic, and the attempt to understand why (mechanisms). Overall, we find that human causal reasoning produces effects independently of LLMs, particularly on the diversity of ideas, and therefore it is worth cultivating causal reasoning in a world in which students use LLMs. Probably less appreciated is that the value of diverse ideas also requires an evaluation system that demands diversity rather than standard solutions.
title: Training novices to think, or giving them LLMs? Evidence from an RCT

abstract: We study the industrial incidence of net zero in DICE-IO, a 33-sector climate-economy model calibrated to global input--output data. The standard smokestack principle suggests that the largest direct emitters should bear the largest transition burden. We show that this incidence logic breaks down in a production network: carbon costs propagate downstream and can weigh most heavily on industries that use carbon-intensive inputs. We summarize this mechanism with a sufficient statistic for first-order price incidence, the Leontief-based embodied-emissions multiplier, which we call Downstream Emission Centrality (DEC). DEC equals the sectoral price response to a marginal Scope-1 carbon tax and explains nearly all cross-sectional price variation along the nonlinear net-zero transition. Achieving the Paris Agreement target requires a carbon tax rising to about $1,300 per ton of CO2 by 2050. The Scope-1 transition has a consumption-equivalent welfare cost of 0.7% relative to laissez-faire, while a Scope-3-style tax on embodied carbon in purchases yields a welfare gain of 1.1%.

abstract: The determinants and optimality of implemented export taxes have long been understudied. In this work, I analyze how a country's optimal export taxes on products are influenced by their usage as inputs in traded final products. I decompose the influence of input–output linkages in the Global Value Chain (GVC) on optimal export policy into three channels in a two‐country trade model with multiple industries and roundabout production. Using China's applied export taxes from 2003 to 2012, I empirically demonstrate that the terms‐of‐trade effect and the three GVC effects are partially accounted for in China's export tax rates. The GVC effects underwent changes following the Global Financial Crisis in 2008. The comparison between calibrated optimal export tax rates and applied export tax rates reveals political bias in China's export tax on differentiated products, particularly in incorporating GVC effects.

abstract: We consider a framework which brings together losses arising from rent-dissipation and the workhorse model of law enforcement. Governmental actors engage in a contest to share the proceeds from the enforcement of the law through monetary fines, which leads to rent-dissipation. This causes monetary sanctions to be costly, rendering the model used for studying nonmonetary sanctions a better fit for their analysis. The effect of rent-dissipation on optimal sanctions is directly related to the sanction elasticity of offenses measured at the classic optimum (i.e., where the expected sanction equals the direct harm from the offense). When offenses are inelastic, the optimal sanction is smaller than the classic optimum and it is decreasing in the degree of rent-dissipation; and a legislator who does not fully internalize contest costs chooses an overly punitive sanction which is smaller than the classic optimum. The opposite results are obtained when offenses are elastic. We discuss implications and extensions.
title: Law enforcement with rent dissipation

abstract: We consider a committee facing binary decisions on a number of proposals. If members vote sincerely and payoffs are symmetrically distributed, we show analytically that simple majority rule is the best q-majority rule in an aggregate or expected payoff sense. We argue that this (well known) pattern changes systematically if the committee faces multiple decisions and members engage in logrolling deals. In a simulation exercise, we find that unanimity rule outperforms majority rule when the number of proposals considered is large enough. We complement our analysis with a laboratory experiment designed to investigate whether human subjects engage in the logrolling deals assumed in our simulations. We find that deals associated with large negative externalities are less likely to arise than others, as are “complex” deals involving many voters or proposals. These results suggest that the impact of logrolling on the relative performance of the decision rules considered may be mitigated by cognitive constraints and other-regarding preferences.
title: Logrolling affects the relative performance of majority and unanimity rule

abstract: Inflation in the US has receded from its 2022 peak. This column uses payroll records from 2016 to 2025 to show that many workers have experienced a lasting reduction in their purchasing power, and argues that the lack of systematic wage indexation in the US is central to this story. When inflation surged, most firms continued to grant familiar raises of 2% to 4%, allowing purchasing power to fall. Once inflation slowed, those raises again produced modest real wage growth but did not compensate workers for what they had already lost.
abstract_zh: 美国通胀已从2022年的峰值回落。本文利用2016年至2025年的工资记录显示，许多工人的购买力经历了持久性下降，并认为美国缺乏系统性的工资指数化机制是这一现象的核心原因。当通胀飙升时，大多数企业继续给予2%至4%的常规加薪，导致购买力下降。一旦通胀放缓，这些加薪再次带来温和的实际工资增长，但并未补偿工人此前已遭受的损失。
title: The inflation rate fell but many workers’ pay cheques did not keep up

abstract: We study international cooperation in a general environment with pecuniary and non-pecuniary externalities across countries. We derive two main theorems, each demonstrating that market-access commitments, a form of shallow integration, are sufficient to implement globally efficient policies. When all cross-border externalities are pecuniary, the first theorem provides a new and unifying perspective on a series of results by Bagwell and Staiger. When some cross-border externalities are non-pecuniary, the second theorem shows that market-access commitments, properly extended, still sustain global efficiency. These extended market-access commitments reinterpret cross-border externalities as additional goods that are traded and priced at their social values. We discuss the implications for international cooperation on climate change and geopolitics.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在存在跨国金钱性外部性与非金钱性外部性的普遍环境中的国际合作。我们推导出两个主要定理，各自证明市场准入承诺——一种浅层一体化形式——足以实施全球高效政策。当所有跨境外部性均为金钱性时，第一个定理为巴格韦尔和斯泰格的一系列结果提供了新的统一视角。当部分跨境外部性为非金钱性时，第二个定理表明，适当扩展的市场准入承诺仍能维持全球效率。这些扩展的市场准入承诺将跨境外部性重新诠释为额外商品，按其社会价值进行交易和定价。我们讨论了这些发现对气候变化和地缘政治国际合作的启示。

abstract: Extreme heat events significantly threaten public health and urban sustainability. Traditional urban green space (UGS) optimization often relies on static census data, failing to capture spatio-temporal variations in human activity and associated thermal risks. This study proposes a spatially explicit multi-objective optimization model to mitigate heat exposure in Xuzhou’s central urban area. Integrating hourly cellular signaling data from three representative time points (08:00, 14:00, and 20:00), the optimization framework utilizes a heuristic search strategy to simultaneously optimize four critical objectives: reducing heat exposure, minimizing conversion cost, enhancing spatial equity, and improving morphological compactness. Three policy-oriented scenarios—balanced development (BD), cost-effective (CE), and social equity (SE)—were simulated to explore the trade-offs between fiscal constraints and climate benefits. The main findings are as follows: (1) The proposed framework effectively captures the spatiotemporal heterogeneity of population heat exposure and generates differentiated UGS layouts under varying policy priorities. (2) The CE scenario achieves the lowest conversion cost, whereas the SE scenario yields higher cooling effectiveness and lower Gini coefficients through dispersed micro-scale green interventions in densely populated areas; the BD scenario provides a balanced compromise among the four objectives. (3) Spatial overlay analysis further identifies no-regret intervention zones that remain stable across scenarios and time periods, which are mainly concentrated on public service land, warehousing land, rural homesteads, and vacant land. This study advances UGS optimization from static, land-oriented planning toward multi-temporal, people-centered climate adaptation, providing practical support for heat mitigation and resilient urban planning in high-density cities.
abstract_zh: 极端高温事件严重威胁公共健康和城市可持续性。传统的城市绿地（UGS）优化往往依赖静态普查数据，难以捕捉人类活动的时空变化及其相关的热风险。本研究提出了一种空间显式的多目标优化模型，以缓解徐州市中心城区的热暴露问题。该优化框架整合了三个代表性时间点（08:00、14:00和20:00）的小时级蜂窝信令数据，采用启发式搜索策略，同时优化四个关键目标：降低热暴露、最小化改造成本、增强空间公平性以及改善形态紧凑度。研究模拟了三种政策导向情景——均衡发展（BD）、成本效益（CE）和社会公平（SE），以探索财政约束与气候效益之间的权衡关系。主要研究发现如下：（1）所提出的框架能够有效捕捉人口热暴露的时空异质性，并在不同政策优先级下生成差异化的绿地布局。（2）CE情景实现了最低的改造成本，而SE情景通过在人口密集区域实施分散的小尺度绿色干预措施，获得了更高的降温效果和更低的基尼系数；BD情景则在四个目标之间提供了均衡的折中方案。（3）空间叠加分析进一步识别出在不同情景和时间段内保持稳定的无遗憾干预区，这些区域主要集中在公共服务用地、仓储用地、农村宅基地和空闲地。本研究将城市绿地优化从静态的、以土地为导向的规划推进到多时相的、以人为本的气候适应策略，为高密度城市的降温减灾和韧性城市规划提供了实践支持。

abstract: Historic landscapes are frequently capitalized into accommodation prices, yet existing valuation frameworks still rely heavily on planar proximity or coarse visibility proxies that fail to capture room-level three-dimensional exposure in dense urban settings. This study develops an automated multi scalar analytical framework that integrates room level three dimensional viewshed modelling, street-view image perception, semantic segmentation, and explainable machine learning to estimate how multidimensional visual exposure translates into hotel room premiums in Beijing’s historic core. The analysis yields four main findings. First, three-dimensional exposure variables, especially maximum visual depth, provide substantially greater explanatory power than conventional visible-area measures, showing that being spatially close is not equivalent to seeing deeply. Second, room premiums respond to visual environments through nonlinear thresholds rather than smooth linear increments: moderate vertical observation conditions and moderate visual complexity are associated with stronger capitalization, whereas excessive visual competition from surrounding buildings rapidly erodes marginal returns. Third, landmark visual connectivity corresponds to discrete rent surges once critical visibility levels are reached, indicating that iconic heritage nodes reflect threshold like spillover effects on nearby accommodation prices. Fourth, both the magnitude and internal structure of visual premiums vary sharply across districts, demonstrating that capitalization is spatially differentiated rather than spatially uniform within the historic core. By shifting valuation from planar proximity to room-level depth, this study advances three-dimensional visibility assessment and provides an operational framework for view-corridor protection, height control, and differentiated heritage-area management in high-density historic environments. abstract_zh: 历史景观常被资本化入住宿价格之中，然而现有的估值框架仍主要依赖平面邻近性或粗略的可见性代理指标，未能捕捉高密度城市环境中房间级别的三维暴露情况。本研究开发了一种自动化的多尺度分析框架，整合了房间级别的三维视域建模、街景图像感知、语义分割及可解释机器学习，以估算多维视觉暴露如何转化为北京历史核心区酒店房间的溢价。分析得出四项主要发现。第一，三维暴露变量，尤其是最大视觉深度，相比传统可见面积指标提供了显著更强的解释力，表明空间上的接近并不等同于视觉上的深入。第二，房间溢价对视觉环境的响应呈现非线性阈值特征，而非平滑线性递增：适度的垂直观察条件和适度的视觉复杂度与更强的资本化效应相关联，而周边建筑过度的视觉竞争则迅速侵蚀边际回报。第三，地标视觉连通性在达到关键可见度水平后对应离散的租金激增，表明标志性遗产节点对周边住宿价格产生类似阈值的溢出效应。第四，视觉溢价的幅度及内部结构在各区域间差异显著，证明在历史核心区内，资本化效应在空间上呈现差异化而非均匀分布。通过将估值从平面邻近性转向房间级别的深度，本研究推进了三维可见性评估，并为高密度历史环境中的视廊保护、高度控制及差异化遗产区管理提供了操作框架。

title: From planar proximity to room-level depth: Nonlinear capitalization of historic landscape visibility in dense urban districts

abstract: Gender and climate change scholars have demonstrated how gendered livelihood (re)produces unequal vulnerabilities between men and women shaped by differentiated adaptive capacities. In response,human-nature interaction scholars underscore the reciprocal relationship between human beings and the environment by highlighting their mutual agency and the ability of environmental change to shape the formation and transformation of gendered livelihoods.Inspired by the human-nature interaction studies,we explore how communities’ responses, coping and adapting to climate change, shape the formation and transformation of gendered livelihood strategies. Drawing on the gendered lens, we explored the everyday lived experiences of rural communities under climate change; analysed gendered livelihood formation (resource access, control and power relations); examined gendered livelihood transformation under climate change; and offered reflections on the implications for resilient livelihood planning. The study found that gendered livelihood practices are transforming as communities’ respond to climate change. Women were found engaged in farming, out-migration, livestock and poultry rearing, complementary but contradictory to livelihood strategies perceived as feminine.The constellation of livelihood activities and strategies practised by women enhanced their resilience capacities to climate change but increased their domestic and economic burdens through simultaneous engagement in productive and reproductive roles. Men were perceived as more vulnerable in adapting their livelihoods to climate change. We argue that policy planning interventions toward rural livelihood enhancement should focus on improving the productive adaptive capacities of both men and women towards fostering resilient livelihoods.
abstract_zh: 性别与气候变化学者已经证明，性别化的生计方式如何（再）生产出男女之间因适应能力差异而形成的不平等脆弱性。对此，人与自然互动研究者通过强调人与环境的相互能动性以及环境变化塑造性别化生计形成与转型的能力，着重指出了人与环境之间的互惠关系。受人与自然互动研究的启发，我们探讨了社区对气候变化的响应、应对及适应过程如何塑造性别化生计策略的形成与转型。借助性别视角，我们考察了气候变化下农村社区的日常实际生活经验；分析了性别化生计的形成（资源获取、控制与权力关系）；审视了气候变化下性别化生计的转型；并就其对韧性生计规划的意义提出了反思。研究发现，随着社区对气候变化的响应，性别化生计实践正在发生转型。女性从事农耕、外出迁移、畜禽养殖等活动，这些活动与被视为女性化的生计策略既互补又矛盾。女性所实践的多样化生计活动与策略组合增强了她们应对气候变化的韧性能力，但同时也通过同时承担生产性与再生产性角色，加重了她们的家务与经济负担。男性在使其生计适应气候变化方面被认为更为脆弱。我们认为，旨在提升农村生计的政策规划干预应着重于提高男性和女性的生产性适应能力，以促进韧性生计的培育。
title: From care-takers to breadwinners? Gendered livelihoods’ dynamics under climate change: Implications for resilient livelihood planning
title_zh: 从照料者到养家者？气候变化下的性别化生计动态：对韧性生计规划的影响

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between political continuity and public municipal debt in Colombia, highlighting how political cycles influence fiscal behavior at subnational level. Unlike national cycles, local political dynamics, marked by consecutive electoral victories of the same party, significantly impact fiscal policy and debt accumulation. Using a Kink Regression Discontinuity design, we explore the effects of these electoral outcomes on public financial debt. Our results show that an additional percentage point in the mayoral win margin increases municipal per capita debt by 2 thousand COP, with larger effects in smaller municipalities and evidence of amplification where the governing party has stronger council representation. The effect strengthens over time, is consistent in sign and magnitude with a complementary difference-in-differences strategy, and remains robust to alternative bandwidth specifications, permutation-based tests, and time-placebo exercises.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政治连续性与哥伦比亚公共市政债务之间的关系，强调了政治周期如何影响地方层面的财政行为。与国家级周期不同，以同一政党连续赢得选举为标志的地方政治动态，显著影响财政政策与债务积累。利用拐点回归不连续设计，我们考察了这些选举结果对公共财政债务的影响。结果显示，市长获胜优势每增加一个百分点，市政人均债务增加2000哥伦比亚比索，在较小城市中效应更为显著，并且有证据表明，在执政党拥有更强议会代表性的地方，该效应会被放大。这一效应随时间增强，其符号和大小与补充性的双重差分策略一致，并且对替代带宽设定、基于置换的检验以及时间安慰剂测试保持稳健。
title: Staying in power: how does political continuity shape debt?
title_zh: 维持权力：政治连续性如何影响债务？

abstract: Sub-Saharan Africa experiences some of the world’s highest deforestation rates, partly because households turn to charcoal production when agricultural shocks reduce farm income. Yet the extent to which alternative coping strategies can offset this pressure on forests remains unclear. This study examines how access to other livelihoods shapes household responses to the first appearance of the Fall Armyworm (FAW) in Zambia. Using four years of household panel data and exploiting spatial variation in FAW intensity, we estimate the causal effects of FAW on charcoal production and local deforestation. We find that low, medium, and severe FAW exposure raise the likelihood of charcoal production by 4.8, 8.6, and 12.3 percentage points, respectively, and are associated with increases in surrounding deforestation of approximately 7.3%, 18.9%, and 26.2%, respectively. However, these effects are substantially smaller among households that diversify crops and use pesticides. In contrast, households engaged in off-farm work are more likely to participate in charcoal production. Our findings show that the environmental consequences of agricultural shocks depend critically on the availability of alternative coping strategies, highlighting the importance of policies that expand non-forest-based livelihood options.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区拥有全球最高的森林砍伐率之一，部分原因在于当农业冲击减少农户收入时，家庭转向木炭生产。然而，替代性应对策略在多大程度上能缓解这种对森林的压力仍不明确。本研究考察了其他生计途径的可及性如何影响家庭对赞比亚首次出现的秋粘虫（FAW）的应对反应。利用四年的家庭面板数据，并利用秋粘虫强度的空间差异，我们估计了秋粘虫对木炭生产和当地森林砍伐的因果效应。研究发现，低、中、高强度的秋粘虫暴露分别使木炭生产的可能性提高4.8、8.6和12.3个百分点，并与周边森林砍伐分别增加约7.3%、18.9%和26.2%相关。然而，在作物多样化种植和使用农药的家庭中，这些效应显著较小。相比之下，从事非农工作的家庭更可能参与木炭生产。我们的研究结果表明，农业冲击的环境后果关键取决于替代性应对策略的可获得性，这凸显了扩大非森林型生计选择政策的重要性。
title: How does the availability of alternative coping strategies influence households’ reliance on charcoal as a coping strategy?
title_zh: 替代应对策略的可得性如何影响家庭对木炭作为应对策略的依赖？

abstract: How do demographic trends shape the adoption of AI and automation technologies? This paper provides the first large-scale cross-country firm-level test of the demographic–automation hypothesis using World Bank Enterprise Surveys data covering 89,380 firms across 144 countries from 2022 to 2025. I classify adopters by applying a large language model to firms’ open-ended process innovation descriptions, identifying 1,656 AI and automation adopters (1.9 percent of the sample). A ten-percentage-point increase in the old-age dependency ratio raises process adoption probability by approximately 0.6 percentage points, after accounting for countries’ income levels, digital infrastructure, firm size and sector, and broad regional and time differences. The result is robust across specifications and supported by an instrumental variable strategy based on predetermined demographic cohort structure. Heterogeneity analysis shows the effect concentrates in manufacturing, large firms, and developing economies for the broad adoption measure; restricting to firms with explicit references to AI reverses the sector pattern, with services firms significantly more likely to adopt than manufacturing firms, pointing to distinct sectoral profiles for software-based AI and hardware-based automation. Aging also predicts firms’ development of AI-enabled products across both manufacturing and services. The results indicate that demographic aging shapes AI and automation adoption through both process and product innovation channels: firms substitute technology for increasingly scarce and costly labor in production, and separately develop AI-enabled products for labor-constrained customers.
title: Aging Economies and AI Adoption: Firm-Level Evidence from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys

abstract: Achieving climate-related commitments and mitigating related risks to macroeconomic and financial stability require improving the conditions for private investment. Raising sufficient private finance is however challenging, particularly for emerging markets and developing economies. This paper develops an analytical framework to assess how reforms shape private climate finance. Key dimensions include macrostructural reforms to lower capital costs, measures to incentivise financing for climate-related investments, and blended financing that leverages public resources to attract private investment. To the extent the resulting externally-financed investments are resilience- and growth-enhancing, these can also support strengthening of the longer-term balance of payments position. Effective implementation may require international support, especially for developing economies
authors: Chen Chen & Charlotte Gardes-Landolfini & Annapurna Mitra & Henk Jan Reinders
title: Private Finance and Climate Investment Needs: An Analytical Framework

abstract: We develop standardized time-series measures of shocks and uncertainty for output growth and inflation across 14 Asia-Pacific economies using data from Consensus Economics survey of professional economic forecasters. They are based on changes in mean forecasts and standard deviations, adjusted for intra-year patterns that arise from the annual-average percent changes basis of the data. As an example of how our shock measures may be used, we apply the vector autoregression method of sign restrictions to decompose output growth and inflation shocks into fundamental demand and supply shocks. Those shocks and our uncertainty measures align well with major economic events such as the Asian Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, and geopolitical conflicts. We show that our uncertainty measures most closely reflect the concept of macroeconomic uncertainty, with apparent differences to established economic policy uncertainty measures across all comparable economies, but a close relationship with two well-known macroeconomic uncertainty measures produced only for the United States. Hence, extending the measures of macroeconomic uncertainty to all 14 economies in our analysis, along with the shocks for those economies, creates a valuable dataset for economic policy setting and empirical research.
title: Measures of Macroeconomic Shocks and Uncertainty for Asia-Pacific Economies

abstract: I analyze multi-horizon market forecasts for macroeconomic variables in Brazil from 2010 to 2026, using a structural macroeconomic model to interpret stated beliefs as the outcomes of a coherent belief system. This produces time-varying beliefs about policy rules, transmission mechanisms, and structural shocks. Beliefs about the monetary policy rule vary in two distinct dimensions, with the perceived target and Taylor response coefficients showing independent variation. Monetary transmission is seen as weak; the perceived Philips and IS curves are very flat. Markets see fiscal policy as increasingly unresponsive to higher debt. The perceived inflation target is unchanged after an unexpected monetary tightening, but the perceived response to inflation increases, with larger effects for monetary surprises and smaller for news shocks.
title: Inferring Structural Beliefs from Macroeconomic Expectations: Evidence from Brazil
